vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: open-websearch
Version: 0.1.1

The skill bundle facilitates the setup and execution of a web search service, which involves high-risk capabilities such as shell command execution (e.g., 'npm install', 'open-websearch serve') and broad network access. While the instructions in SKILL.md and references/setup.md are transparent, include defensive measures against prompt injection from external web content, and mandate user confirmation for risky actions, the inherent nature of these capabilities (shell and network access) meets the threshold for a suspicious classification despite the lack of clear malicious intent.

llm.summary: The skill's requests and runtime instructions align with an 'open-websearch' setup/retrieval helper and do not ask for unrelated credentials or hidden installs.

dimensions.detail: The name/description (open-websearch setup and focused live retrieval) match the SKILL.md: it prefers local CLI/daemon, supports workspace-exposed MCP tools, and lists retrieval rules consistent with that purpose. No unrelated binaries or secrets are requested.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Instructions are conservative: they require detecting available paths, asking before installs/daemon start/config changes, validating status, and preferring minimal retrieval. The docs reference environment variables used for optional browser-assisted paths (e.g., PLAYWRIGHT_EXECUTABLE_PATH, PLAYWRIGHT_WS_ENDPOINT, FETCH_WEB_INSECURE_TLS) and npm proxy/registry settings — these are sensible for browser or install flows but are not separately declared as required env vars. The skill explicitly instructs to ask the user before reading/changing configs or performing risky actions.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: This is instruction-only with no install spec or bundled code. It may recommend npm installs (Playwright) in specific optional flows but always requires user confirmation before installing; no remote archive downloads or opaque installers are included.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: No credentials or config paths are required. References to proxy, npm mirror, and Playwright-related env vars are appropriate for optional browser-assisted or install paths and do not appear disproportionate to the skill's stated activities.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill is not always-enabled and does not demand permanent presence. It may, with user consent, start a local daemon or modify MCP/client config — actions the SKILL.md explicitly says must be confirmed prior to execution. Users should be aware these actions can change the runtime environment if they approve them.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears coherent and conservative: it will try to reuse existing local or workspace tools, ask before installing packages or starting daemons, and validate status before claiming success. Before allowing any action: (1) require the agent to show the exact commands it will run (especially npm installs or 'open-websearch serve' startup), (2) deny any configuration edits or installs you don't understand, and (3) be cautious about granting network access for browser installs or Playwright downloads in restricted environments. No secrets or unrelated credentials are requested by the skill itself.
